examples.arabic: امي عملتلنا فشار وشاي مسكر وقعدت جنب ابويا اللي كان متوتر اوي
examples.english: My mom made us popcorn and sweet tea and sat next to my dad who was very nervous.
examples.transliteration: ommy 3amaletlena feshar wa shay mesakkar wa 2a3adet ganb abouya elly kan metwattar awy
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

examples.arabic: احنا بنشرب شاي مسكر بعد الاكل
